component.name: Telamon Updater
component.summary: Update Telamon OS, go back to the previous version, and pick a channel

description.p: Telamon Updater shows the Telamon OS version you are running, the update that is waiting for a restart, and the version you can go back to. It reads the release notes of the new version, updates Flatpak apps, and lets you restart now or at a time you choose.
It never collects usage data. If it crashes, it can save a report with system information and resource use, but nothing is sent unless you choose to send it.
Renamed to Telamon Updater (it was Atlas Updater). Your settings and history come along.
